mapper.select: SELECT `id`, `tenant_id`, `campaign_id`, `script_flow_version_id`, `flow_node_key`, `contact_id`, `campaign_contact_key`, `phone`, `mode`, `status`, `attempts`, `max_attempts`, `last_error`, `human_agent_id`, `handoff_reason`, `recording_url`, `ai_session_id`, `telephony_call_id`, `telephony_line_id`, `gateway_node_id`, `gateway_endpoint`, `conversation_id`, `voice_ai_pipeline`, `last_transcript`, `summary`, `started_at`, `finished_at`, `next_attempt_at`, `created_at`, `updated_at` FROM `callsession` WHERE `id` = #{id,jdbcType=CHAR,typeHandler=com.duozhi.outbound.mapper.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler} AND `tenant_id` = #{tenantId,jdbcType=INTEGER}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM callsession WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND contact_id = #{contactId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(attempts),0) FROM callsession WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND phone = #{phone} AND created_at >= #{start}
SELECT * FROM callsession WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND phone = #{phone} AND id <> #{exclude,typeHandler=com.duozhi.outbound.mapper.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM callsession WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND finished_at <= #{cutoff} AND next_attempt_at IS NULL AND status IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','NO_ANSWER','BUSY','VOICEMAIL') AND (phone NOT LIKE 'redacted:%' OR last_transcript IS NOT NULL OR summary IS NOT NULL OR recording_url IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY finished_at,id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND human_agent_id=#{p1} AND status NOT IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','NO_ANSWER','BUSY','VOICEMAIL')
SELECT * FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{p1}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND campaign_id=#{p1} AND status='CREATED'
SELECT * FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND campaign_id=#{p1} AND attempts=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND campaign_id=#{p1} AND next_attempt_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT * FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND campaign_id=#{p1} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND campaign_id=#{p1} AND status='CREATED'
SELECT * FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND campaign_id=#{p1} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND campaign_id=#{p1}
SELECT * FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND phone=#{p1}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId}
SELECT * FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{p1}
SELECT * FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{p1}
SELECT * FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND phone=#{p1} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND created_at>=#{p1} ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status IN ('DIALING','ANSWERED','IN_AI','WAITING_HUMAN','HANDOFF_TRANSFERRING','IN_HUMAN')
SELECT * FROM callsession WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id,typeHandler=com.duozhi.outbound.mapper.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND campaign_id=#{p1} AND (status IN ('DIALING','ANSWERED','IN_AI','WAITING_HUMAN','HANDOFF_TRANSFERRING','IN_HUMAN') OR status='QUEUED' OR next_attempt_at IS NOT NULL)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (human_agent_id=#{p0} AND id<>#{p1} AND status IN ('DIALING','ANSWERED','IN_AI','WAITING_HUMAN','HANDOFF_TRANSFERRING','IN_HUMAN'))

SELECT * FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (status IN ('DIALING','ANSWERED','IN_AI','WAITING_HUMAN','HANDOFF_TRANSFERRING','IN_HUMAN') AND updated_at<=#{p0}) ORDER BY updated_at,id LIMIT #{p1}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (human_agent_id=#{p0} AND id<>#{p1} AND status IN ('DIALING','ANSWERED','IN_AI','WAITING_HUMAN','HANDOFF_TRANSFERRING','IN_HUMAN'))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (gateway_node_id=#{p0} AND status IN ('DIALING','ANSWERED','IN_AI','WAITING_HUMAN','HANDOFF_TRANSFERRING','IN_HUMAN'))
SELECT * FROM `callsession` WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (attempts<max_attempts AND (status='QUEUED' OR (next_attempt_at IS NOT NULL AND next_attempt_at<=#{p0}))) ORDER BY updated_at LIMIT 100

SELECT * FROM callsession WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND attempts<max_attempts AND status IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','NO_ANSWER','BUSY','VOICEMAIL') AND next_attempt_at IS NOT NULL AND next_attempt_at<=#{p0} ORDER BY updated_at,id LIMIT 100
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(attempts),0) FROM callsession WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND started_at>=#{p1}

SELECT * FROM callsession WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND human_agent_id=#{agentId} AND campaign_id=#{campaignId} AND status=#{status} AND (human_agent_id=#{opsUser} OR id IN(SELECT call_session_id FROM handoffrequest WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND assigned_agent_id=#{opsUser} AND state IN('WAITING','ACCEPTING','ACCEPTED')) OR contact_id IN (SELECT contact_id FROM ops_lead WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND (owner_id=#{opsUser} OR owner_id IN (SELECT m.user_id FROM ops_member m JOIN ops_member me ON me.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND me.team_id=m.team_id AND me.is_lead=TRUE JOIN ops_team t ON t.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND t.id=m.team_id AND t.enabled=TRUE WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND me.user_id=#{opsUser}))) OR human_agent_id IN(SELECT m.user_id FROM ops_member m JOIN ops_member me ON me.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND me.team_id=m.team_id AND me.is_lead=TRUE JOIN ops_team t ON t.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND t.id=m.team_id AND t.enabled=TRUE WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND me.user_id=#{opsUser})) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT * FROM callsession WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND created_at >= #{since} AND status=#{status} AND (created_at < #{lastCreated} OR (created_at=#{lastCreated} AND id < #{lastId,typeHandler=com.duozhi.outbound.mapper.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler})) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 250

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM callsession WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status IN ('DIALING','ANSWERED','IN_AI','WAITING_HUMAN','HANDOFF_TRANSFERRING','IN_HUMAN') AND telephony_line_id=#{line} AND campaign_id=#{campaign}

SELECT COUNT(c.id) AS calls,SUM(CASE WHEN (c.status IN ('ANSWERED','IN_AI','WAITING_HUMAN','HANDOFF_TRANSFERRING','IN_HUMAN','COMPLETED') OR a.result_code IN ('interested','qualified_lead','positive_lead','appointment','converted','rejected','completed')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reached,SUM(CASE WHEN c.status='COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed,SUM(CASE WHEN c.status IN ('FAILED','NO_ANSWER','BUSY','VOICEMAIL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed,COUNT(a.id) AS analyzed,SUM(CASE WHEN a.result_code IN ('interested','qualified_lead','positive_lead','appointment','converted') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS interested,SUM(CASE WHEN a.review_state<>'reviewed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_reviews,AVG(a.qa_score) AS average_qa_score FROM callsession c LEFT JOIN callanalysis a ON a.call_session_id=c.id AND a.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.created_at >= #{since}

SELECT c.campaign_id,COUNT(c.id) AS calls,SUM(CASE WHEN (c.status IN ('ANSWERED','IN_AI','WAITING_HUMAN','HANDOFF_TRANSFERRING','IN_HUMAN','COMPLETED') OR a.result_code IN ('interested','qualified_lead','positive_lead','appointment','converted','rejected','completed')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reached,SUM(CASE WHEN a.result_code IN ('interested','qualified_lead','positive_lead','appointment','converted') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS interested FROM callsession c LEFT JOIN callanalysis a ON a.call_session_id=c.id AND a.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.created_at >= #{since} AND c.campaign_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.campaign_id ORDER BY COUNT(c.id) DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT status,COUNT(*) AS n FROM callsession WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY status
SELECT status AS value,COUNT(*) AS total FROM callsession WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY status
SELECT voice_ai_pipeline AS value,COUNT(*) AS total FROM callsession WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY voice_ai_pipeline
SELECT c.* FROM callsession c WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.id=#{id,typeHandler=com.duozhi.outbound.mapper.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM callsession WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND phone=#{phone} AND id<>#{id} AND status IN ('DIALING','ANSWERED','IN_AI','WAITING_HUMAN','HANDOFF_TRANSFERRING','IN_HUMAN')
